20152.long_desc: Highest quality Gun Pedal Assembly for your favourite shooter arcade machines. This is the microswitch version assembly and is a direct replacement for Namco Time Crisis machine series. Easily upgradeable to LED lighting, Opto switch and USB use. Made with 2mm steel constructions and 4.5mm checkerplate, the Arcooda gun pedal assembly is powder coated (not painted), with interchangeable parts with the Namco original pedal assembly, and weights 4.5kgs for arcade commercial use. Arcade Use & Compatibility The pedal assembly is suitable for a large variety of your favourite Namco shooter machines: - Time Crisis 1 - Time Crisis 2 - Time Crisis 3 - Time Crisis 4 - Razing Storm - Crisis Zone - Blade of Honor Home Use & Light Gun Machines Choose between standard wiring which has simple switch circuit - this can be used for JAMMA game boards or simple switch based homebrew machines, or, use our USB wiring harness which offers USB programmable pedal switch via connection to your PC/computer. If you are using this foot pedal assembly with your PC, order the #20210 harness which has embedded chipset that when you plug in your foot pedal assembly into your arcade or homebrew cabinet Pedal Colour Options The Gun Pedal Assembly comes in the following options: - Red - Yellow (10pc minimum order) - White (10pc minimum order) - Black (10pc minimum order) Upgradeability - LED Lighting: Our Gun Pedal Assembly comes with underfloor acrylic, providing you with the ability to add your own lighting circuit or our Arcooda’s LED light PCB’s for more effect for your arcade machine. - Opto Switch: easily replace the microswitch with Opto switch for Time Crisis 4. Cable Options Depending on what system you are connecting to with your pedal, we provide you with options of cables to assist you. Pedal Assembly Cable for Namco Arcade Machine 15cm Perfect for use with an original Namco Time Crisis 1 or 2 Cabinet, as well as wanting to use for microswitch function only. Pedal Assembly Cable with Switch and LED Plug 200cm Choose this option if considering using with pedal assembly in the future with the LED upgrade and with microswitch function Pedal Assembly Cable with Switch LED and USB Plug 200cm This option is perfect if you are looking to acquire the LED upgrade alongside USB support via PC and computer use. Bracket Options We also provide options to connect your foot pedal assembly to your arcade cabinet, as a set of 2 pieces including 8 mounting bolts. Made from 2.4mm powder coated steel, it includes left and right brackets in either Red, or Black. Dual Plug Position To match the Namco arcade machines, the default position of the plug is on the top position. However, if you are using for home use, simply open the pedal assembly and move the plug position to the bottom opening - this avoids any trip hazard if you plan to use the arcade pedal assembly version for home use. If you are looking for a plug and play LED light gun pedal assembly, please consider our black Arcooda LED pedal assembly.
